name: How long does terrace installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does terrace installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a terrace installation varies significantly based on factors like the size and complexity of the design, the chosen materials, and site conditions. A smaller, straightforward terrace might take a few weeks, while a larger, custom-designed luxury terrace with intricate features could take several weeks to a few months. Weather conditions and permitting timelines can also influence the schedule. We provide a detailed timeline after the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity, ranging from a few weeks for smaller terraces to several months for larger, custom designs.
